Mira (CS): FYI, Parallax just reported a reproducible issue where regenerated responses start echoing the original prompt/token history, causing runaway tokens and higher billing. They provided a quick repro and logs. Can we triage? :eyes:

Raj (Eng Runtime): Repro steps pasted?

Mira (CS): Yep — paste from customer below. They say it happens when using session regeneration + short prefix context and multiple regen calls. Customer example: 1) create session with session_id=parallax-123 2) send prompt 'Summarize monthly sales' 3) regen the response 2x. After second regen, model repeats the full prompt text before answering.

Mira (CS): Repro curl (sanitized):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/regenerate \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"model":"redwood-medium-v1","session_id":"parallax-123","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Summarize monthly sales"}],"regen":true}'
```

Mira (CS): Example response snippet from their logs (trimmed):
```
{
  "request_id":"req_0b9f3a","response":"Summarize monthly sales
Summarize monthly sales
Q1 sales were..."
}
```

Lina (Product): Oof. Business impact? Are they seeing actual double billing or just repeated content?

Mira (CS): Both. Token count is spiking because the output contains repeated prompt text; for larger prompts it's adding hundreds of tokens. Customer reported 3x cost on a few calls. They're blocking a demo next week.

Anton (Support): Any workaround? Can they disable regen for now?

Mira (CS): They can avoid regen, but regeneration is core to their UX. They asked us to prioritize.

Raj (Eng Runtime): Thanks — initial hypothesis: KV cache or prefix stitching bug when regen=true + session resume. Maybe the prefix from the previous response is being appended instead of replacing the ephemeral prompt. Quick ask: can Mira share the full raw event log (headers + request_id) for one failing call? I want to correlate with runtime traces.

Mira (CS): Pasting minimal log chunk (redacted):
```
[2026-03-01T14:12:03Z] req=req_0b9f3a session=parallax-123 evt=recv messages=[{"role":"user","c":"Summarize monthly sales"}]
[2026-03-01T14:12:04Z] req=req_0b9f3a session=parallax-123 evt=gen prefix_cache_key=pc_9b2
[2026-03-01T14:12:05Z] req=req_0b9f3a session=parallax-123 evt=regen regen_count=2 joined_prefix="Summarize monthly sales"
```

Raj (Eng Runtime): Nice. That prefix_cache_key looks suspect. Could be cache key collision between original prompt and regen path. I'll try reproducing locally with their session_id.

Anton (Support): Assign priority? Customer demo next Wed, risk of churn if not fixed. I'd say P1 for customer-impacting bug.

Lina (Product): Agreed P1. Lina -> rollout criteria: we need a fix that prevents duplication + unit tests + a minimal e2e reproducer that CS can run; plus a short mitigation docs for Support. Canary rollout to 10% for Dedicated first, monitor token delta.

Raj (Eng Runtime): Will investigate. Quick checklist: 1) local repro 2) root cause (cache/append vs replace) 3) unit test on cache behavior 4) create E2E script for CS 5) PR + canary. I can start tonight.

Mira (CS): I've uploaded the customer's repro prompt set to the shared drive and linked in the ticket. Ticket ref: #INC-4539 (internal).

Raj (Eng Runtime): If anyone wants to help repro quickly, run this node snippet to simulate regen path (replace KEY):
```
const fetch = require('node-fetch');
async function regen() {
  const body = {model:'redwood-medium-v1', session_id:'parallax-123', messages:[{role:'user',content:'Summarize monthly sales'}], regen:true};
  const r1 = await fetch('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/regenerate',{method:'POST',headers:{'Authorization':'Bearer '+process.env.KEY,'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify(body)});
  console.log(await r1.json());
}
regen();
```

Anton (Support): Adding this to the customer-facing incident note: we have an engineering investigation opened and a workaround (disable regen). Will update customer.

deploy-bot: Created issue #7892 in redwood/infra (labels: bug, p1, regen).

Raj (Eng Runtime): I grabbed #7892 and added initial hypothesis + trace links. I'll push a small fix branch tomorrow AM and include unit tests.

Lina (Product): For prioritization: please estimate EOW? If not possible, rough ETA so Support can communicate.

Raj (Eng Runtime): EOW for a hotfix + tests, canary next Tue. If scope grows (architecture-level change), we'll update.

Mira (CS): Thanks all. I'll send Parallax the interim note and confirm they can disable regen for demo.

Lina (Product): Good. Keep me posted in the issue and drop a short postmortem bullet list after the fix. :thumbsup:

Raj (Eng Runtime): Will do.

Mira (CS): Closing the loop here — I'll follow up in #7892 and update customer once canary is green.
